name: GitKraken CLI
description: Manages multi-repo work items, AI commits and pull requests from the terminal, and gives coding agents a local MCP server for git, issues, and PRs.

skills.name: Multi-Repo Work Items
skills.description: Groups several repositories into one work item so you can commit, push, and open pull requests across them together.

skills.name: AI Commits and PRs
skills.description: Writes commit messages and pull request descriptions with AI through gk work commit --ai and gk work pr create --ai.

skills.name: Local MCP Server
skills.description: Gives coding agents git operations, issue tracking, and pull request workflows across GitHub, GitLab, Jira and Azure DevOps.
